subject: Terms of Use
author: ZombieTron
body:
Personal attacks are prohibited in the Terms of Use of BurnoutAholics.com.

So far I have moderated this site by posting guidelines within my own blog. If there are further breaches of the Terms of Use more direct action will be taken.

subject: RE: There have recently been some derogatory remarks...
author: thephilofwar
body:
There have recently been some derogatory remarks to fans of Burnout in Criterion's podcasts.  I hardly feel that taking offense to that would cause someone to be, "not a fan of the Burnout series;" to say that objection or discussion about something is wrong entirely without question, is McCarthyism. 

I feel that if there is an injustice, it should be brought to the eyes of the public... though I will admit that I tend to have strong opinions at times.

__________

This is the truth that I am revealing before you! Behold; those who hear me now, have got ears to hear from!
